review.tagline: Voice-operated shared Kanban board using the OpenAI Realtime API
review.summary: A Go server that hosts a WebRTC room (Pion), mixes participant audio, and streams it to an OpenAI Realtime peer. The model uses function calling to create, move, tag, edit and delete Kanban cards, and changes are broadcast to everyone in the room. Instructions, tools and seed cards live in kanban.go.
review.audience: Developers prototyping voice-driven tools on the OpenAI Realtime API
strengths: Small Go codebase; instructions, tools and seed cards are all in kanban.go
Multiple participants share one room and one live board
Realtime model overridable via OPENAI_REALTIME_MODEL (default gpt-realtime-2)
weaknesses: No authentication or access control; anyone with the URL can join
Requires an OpenAI API key; no local or other model providers
Background audio can be misread as board updates; headphones advised
No Docker setup; needs Go 1.24+ and the Opus library via pkg-config
needs: Needs OpenAI Realtime API, Go 1.24+, Opus library, pkg-config
